questions.explanation: Domes (like Pantheon) shed water effectively through slope; the comparison is false. Both are highly functional structural elements, not decorative. questions.explanation: Elements are designed simultaneously to address multiple needs, not sequentially added. This oversimplifies; actual design requires elements serving multiple functions. All four needs are equally important and integrated. Every architectural element is multifunctional: walls enclose space (shelter), support loads (structure), control weather/light (environmental control), and define circulation paths.
